transcript:
Advisor: Hi Linda, it's Sarah. How's the garden?
Linda: Overflowing. I've been giving zucchini to the entire street. Nobody answers their door anymore.
Advisor: Ha. So the distribution is still $2,500 a month and the portfolio is on target.
Linda: Good. Now, remind me how the required minimum distribution works again? My neighbor was talking about hers and I got confused.
Advisor: Sure. Each year the IRS requires you to take a minimum amount from your IRA. Your monthly payments already add up to more than that, so you're covered automatically.
Linda: Oh, right, that's what you told me last time. Okay, good. I just wanted to hear it again.
Advisor: That's what I'm here for.
Linda: Michael and the kids are coming for Labor Day. Emma wants to learn to make my peach pie.
Advisor: That sounds lovely. No changes to the plan then?
Linda: No changes. Same as always.
Advisor: Great. Talk to you in the winter.
